title: BACKND Base chart (CDN game data)
summary: CDN-delivered design/game data (charts) via Backend.CDN.Content: list chart tables, fetch chart content, and cache it locally (save/load/update/delete/reset). Used for balancing tables and static game data distributed over CDN.
capabilities: route chart-table and chart-content retrieval questions
explain local caching of chart data and its lifecycle
relate charts to probability cards (both under Backend.CDN)
prerequisites: Chart tables and files are registered/selected in the BACKND console
common_pitfalls: Expecting charts without a selected chart file (excluded from the list)
Treating local cache as always fresh without update
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating chart retrieval/caching code.
Confirm console chart-file selection requirements upstream.
public_notes: Charts are CDN-distributed design data under Backend.CDN.Content.
Local cache lifecycle (save/load/update/delete/reset) must be managed explicitly.
